name: Gran Melia Palacio de Isora
insider_take: This palatial resort sits majestically on Tenerife's sun-kissed southwest coast, where dramatic volcanic landscapes meet pristine Atlantic waters in perfect harmony.
whats_special: The resort boasts Europe's largest saltwater lake pool system spanning over 3,000 square meters, plus direct access to Playa de la Enramada's black volcanic sand beach. Built in traditional Canarian architectural style, it offers stunning views of La Gomera island and features one of Spain's most comprehensive spa facilities with volcanic stone treatments.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the rooftop restaurant – the views of Mount Teide (Spain's highest peak) glowing against the Atlantic horizon are absolutely breathtaking and perfect for photos.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature Red Level adults-only experience with exclusive beach club access, and venture to nearby Los Gigantes cliffs (15 minutes away) – these 800-meter volcanic walls rising from the sea are among Europe's most spectacular natural formations.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location with dramatic volcanic landscape views
Multiple infinity pools including adult-only areas with exceptional design
World-class spa with volcanic stone treatments and wellness programs
Diverse dining options including Michelin-recommended restaurants
Spacious suites with premium amenities and modern luxury finishes
cons: Large resort size may feel less intimate for some guests
Premium location reflects in higher price point
